options.misconception: Applied only the excluded-volume attraction and omitted the b correction
Correct application of the principle
Applied only the volume correction and omitted the attraction term
Used the ideal gas law and ignored both corrections

questions.explanation: The van der Waals equation corrects the ideal law for molecular attraction and finite size: P equals nRT over (V minus nb) minus a n squared over V squared. Correct application of the principle

questions.explanation: Fugacity is the effective pressure that replaces pressure in thermodynamic expressions for real gases, defined as the fugacity coefficient times the true pressure, f equals phi P.
